name: Google Generative AI Baseline 2026-09-14

source.report: Search Console · Performance on Search Generative AI Features
notes: Impressions only — this report does not isolate AI clicks or underlying queries.
Chart is property-aggregated; page table can sum higher when multiple SMPL URLs appear in one generative response.

interpretation: Google is beginning to retrieve SMPL as generative source material. Buyer-intent/category pages (especially Best FP&A) outperform narrow thought leadership. Complementary to ChatGPT Search baseline (1/46), which measures shortlist classification rather than retrieval.
